summary.en: Retry transient Windows access errors while atomically saving Desktop account and other file-backed state.
summary.zh: 原子保存 Desktop 账号及其他文件型状态时，重试 Windows 瞬时访问错误。

compatibilityExceptions.reason: Mobile uses the client-safe runtime face; atomic-write is reached only through host-side dev and peer manifest edges and is not bundled into the Capacitor WebView artifact.
